Scope: the dragon's own look and sounds only. The helicopter's look, the flame look and the horse rider are UNCHANGED, except that the seated
rider's mounted pose is now given to ANY mount (a horse, a dragon) — the motorcycle keeps its riding pose. Drawn from the measured kits: box parts,
the bird's wing roles (WingLeft / WingRight) with the dragon's own beat, the quadruped's legs, the turret / gun roles for the neck and head.
